title: Man dies after being shot, by Ottawa police, SIU says
article: A man shot by Ottawa police along Highway 417 has died of his injuries, the province's Special Investigations Unit said yesterday.
Richard Bastien, 43, of Montreal, who had been in hospital after being shot Wednesday, died yesterday.
According to the SIU, police were pursuing a vehicle wanted in an attempted murder investigation, and a chase ensued on the highway in rush-hour traffic.
The SIU says Mr. Bastien got out of the car and "interacted" with three officers before producing a handgun. An officer fired a number of shots, striking Mr. Bastien once in the chest.
The victim of the attempted murder was shot multiple times and was reportedly in fair condition in hospital.
